title: Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Michael Gregory is Clinical Professor of Law at Harvard Law School, where he serves as the faculty director of the Youth Advocacy & Policy Lab, and teaches and practices law as part of the Trauma and Learning Policy Initiative (TLPI). TLPI is a partnership between Harvard Law School and Massachusetts Advocates for Children. TLPI’s mission […]
